blocks.html: Cosy Cup Library Cafe Backyard, West Side Ave, Jersey City
You’ve never had a Thursday morning like this one.
We’ve got a first for Jersey City, and we think you’re exactly the kind of person who shows up for it.
Lady L Cannabis is teaming up with our friends at Cosy Cup Library Cafe to throw JC’s very first daybreaker – because who says mornings have to be boring?
WEST SIDE MORNING GLORY VOL. 1 | Coffee. Cannabis. Community. Before work.

Picture it: the sun’s barely up, the iced drip coffee is flowing, the ganja is strong, and DJ Chris Back East is spinning beats that’ll make you forget you have a 9AM standup. This is a backyard hang for people who want to start their day a little differently, with good company, good music, and yes, a little something to take the edge off before the grind begins.
Dance before deadlines. We’ll see you there.

📅 When: Thursday, July 16
⏰ Time: 8:00–10:00AM
📍 Where: Cosy Cup Library Cafe Backyard, West Side Ave, Jersey City
🎧 Music: DJ Chris Back East
☕ Vibe: Iced drip coffee, cannabis, community – all before your day even starts
This is a limited series, so if this one’s a hit, there’s more where it came from. But Vol. 1 is where it starts, and we’d love for you to be part of it.
Stock up before the event – unfortunately we cannot distribute cannabis products at the cafe, but our shop is ready to meet all of your cannabis hopes & dreams ahead of the rager.
Come as you are. Leave ready to take on the day (eventually).

See you at sunrise,
The Lady L Team
